method: Static source comparison, JSON integrity and rustfmt parse/format only. No Cargo/rustc/Go test or Windows/game/desktop execution.

mapping.contract: Repair uses authenticated original CON, recorded State.Identity.Release and PID/creation-time consumer; only original unbind can use cleanup-only disk publication despite missing/modified main addon. The caller retains original client/window/CON guards and records disconnect intent before minting capability. The Go test covers already-closed old-release retirement; new Rust modified-disk fixtures are derived from the fixed production path, not claimed Go test executions.

Same shared maintenance/publication admission, validated original-release pool, exact consumer/runtime/nonce/payload reservation, forward route bytes, idempotence and original control. Cleanup cap cannot authorize any bind/prepare/commit/confirm/release action. No main receipt check is added to the fixed repair path.

Check all receipt failure closes, keep original successful receipt owner through physical burst, and consume it before both lock closes. Each full ToolkitError, including nested FILE_CLEANUP_SCHEMA primary/cleanup/control, remains intact. Reserved is still a separate operation error with captured owner, for native operation/close join.

guardContract: Authenticate original CON under its existing execution lease and persist RequestClose before first repair publication.
Use State.Identity.Release and original PID/creation-time consumer; the exact persisted unbind retains runtime/owner/fence/GUID/build/nonce/ticket/index/start_slot.
Confirm original client/window/ownership before publication lease acquisition and recheck after admission; do not call a clean-addon guard for repair.
Mint capability when the exact journaled unbind exists, not when the backend opens. It adds no pre-open close proof that the Go flow lacks.
Invoke repair methods on the already-held PublicationLease; never reacquire maintenance/publication while holding that lease.
Retain all native fresh INPUT, callback, exact receipt and route verification. Close before receipt wait and join operation/close errors without flattening Reserved.
productionApi.integrationStatus: Production delivery API implemented; native backend/doctor adapter consumption is a separately owned pending batch. This freeze does not claim modified-addon CloseForRepair works through the public CLI yet.

differences: Checked receipt close is authorized resource-safety hardening. Historical Rust replaced/dropped successful receipt owners and dropped early failure handles; this preserves original successful owner until burst close and explicitly finishes every opened rejection. The Go delivery repair path does not read the main addon receipt.
faultLimits: Disk fixtures exercise production API/file layout. Read error uses a real valid write-only File. Seek/read/oversize validation uses an explicit model reader. Close failures are helper-injected after actual successful fixture closes, not kernel/CloseHandle failures; no native execution or Rust test pass is claimed.
historicalEvidence: Existing 38 slot_publication tests preserved byte-for-byte; they were not all run historically and are not claimed passed here. This batch adds 13 declarations (51 total), all NOT_RUN.
